concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with, approximately synonymous with 'model'
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's source text uses 'assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: information_available_to_assistant
concepts.gloss: I is information the assistant can provide, i.e. information within its knowledge or capability
concepts.inference: the phrase 'the information it can' presupposes a class of information the assistant is able to provide

concepts.name: speculation_or_lack_of_insight
concepts.gloss: S is a matter on which the assistant is speculating or lacks insight
concepts.inference: the phrase 'where it's speculating or doesn't have insight' identifies a class of subject matters
